deadline.value: We encourage prospective Ph.D. students to apply by Dec. 10 to start in the fall of the following year. We also accept applications year-round and review them quarterly.
deadline.quote: We encourage prospective Ph.D. students to apply by Dec. 10 to start in the fall of the following year. We also accept applications year-round and review them quarterly.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study; ETS offers no Biomedical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on program admissions page.

funding.value: We provide a stipend to all students in our program. All tuition and student fees are waived for full-time students who are members of Graduate Researchers United.
funding.quote: We provide a stipend to all students in our program. Please see the stipend policy for current rates. All tuition and student fees are waived for full-time students who are members of Graduate Researchers United. Students are also eligible for health and dental insurance.

entry_route.value: Applicants should have taken undergraduate classes in engineering or other basic sciences with a strong math component; there are no specific undergraduate course requirements for admission.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have taken undergraduate classes in engineering or other basic sciences with a strong math component. However, there are no specific undergraduate course requirements for admission. The GRE is not required.

gre_general.value: We do not require the GRE and there are no GRE subject test requirements.
gre_general.quote:
What GRE score do I need? Do I need to complete a GRE subject test?
We do not require the GRE and there are no GRE subject test requirements.
